name: nd-cross-border-tax
description: Use when a taxpayer or business crosses North Dakota borders (tax year 2025 figures): nonresident and part-year ND filing on Form ND-1, the ND-Minnesota and ND-Montana reciprocity agreements, military-service sourcing, the credit for income tax paid to another state, and the 0%/1.95%/2.50% bracket schedule (single: 0% to $48,475, 1.95% to $244,825, 2.50% above) verified from the Tax Commissioner's individual page. Trigger on North Dakota nonresident, ND-1 part-year, ND Minnesota reciprocity, ND military pay, credit for tax paid another state North Dakota. Source-cited draft; reciprocity and military cites need statute confirmation (ndlegis.nd.gov unreachable 2026-10-25).
